out.subject: 1.4404 bar – volume commitment and indexed terms
out.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining the alloy, labour and processing components. I appreciate the transparency. The annual movements you cite deserve consideration, but the starting price should also reflect the more recent market evidence; please see the figures below.

Our annual requirement for this bar is fixed at 23,700 kg. Under the proposed term sheets, we would commit to that quantity bindingly. My preference is a 36-month agreement: it gives Werdenfels a firm volume commitment rather than a series of individual enquiries.

We propose €5.40 per kg for 36 months, with payment at 90 days net and an AS-14404 index clause covering a 45% material share, based on 2026-08, with a 5% deadband. We also submit a 24-month package at €5.40 per kg with the same payment and index terms.

This combines dependable volume for you with a transparent mechanism for alloy movements. Please review the packages against your calculation and let us know whether the longer commitment supports agreement on these terms.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Open with a binding annual volume commitment under the proposed packages, prioritising the longer term. Both packages include alloy indexation and extended payment terms. Supply the recent alloy-index evidence without restating claim figures.

out.subject: Revised bar supply package for committee review
out.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for the price adjustment, for verifying the alloy data and for accepting the longer volume commitment and index mechanism. Those are useful steps towards agreement.

I recognise the annual cost movements you describe. For the starting price, please also consider the recent processing-price evidence below alongside the alloy evidence already verified.

We can move to €5.48 per kg for a 36-month agreement with payment at 90 days net. Your message lists that payment term but also says 30 days is required. To address that condition, we submit a separate package at €5.41 per kg with payment at 30 days net, also for 36 months.

Both packages retain the AS-14404 clause with a 45% material share, base month 2026-08 and a 5% deadband, together with the binding annual quantity of 23,700 kg under the term sheets.

Please take these packages and the supporting figures to your pricing committee. Our preference remains the 90-day package; please confirm which payment basis you can approve and review the corresponding price as a complete package.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Moves the price towards the supplier while retaining the accepted volume and index terms. Addresses the inconsistent payment wording with distinct packages and adds processing-index evidence for committee review.

out.subject: Bar supply agreement – remaining price adjustment
out.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for incorporating the verified processing-price data and confirming payment at 90 days net with the 36-month commitment. That resolves the payment point. I also understand that you do not share further detail on your cost structure; we need not reopen that discussion.

With the commercial framework settled, I propose €5.47 per kg under the attached term sheet. It retains the binding annual quantity of 23,700 kg for 36 months, payment at 90 days net and the AS-14404 index clause covering a 45% material share, with base month 2026-08 and a 5% deadband.

For the remaining price review, please also consider our purchase-order history below. It documents the existing business behind the longer volume commitment, alongside the market evidence you have already verified.

Please put this package to your pricing committee and confirm its best approved price on that basis. We are keeping the agreed payment and index terms unchanged so the review can focus on the starting price.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Preserve the approved payment and index framework, add purchase-order evidence, and request committee approval of a modest remaining price adjustment without repeating an earlier proposal.

out.subject: Confirmation of your revised supply offer
out.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for reviewing the processing-price evidence and confirming that you can approve payment at 90 days net with the 36-month volume commitment. Your clarification resolves the payment point, and we appreciate the adjustment to your price.

We accept your revised offer of €5.50 per kg, with payment at 90 days net and a contract term of 36 months. The AS-14404 index clause remains as agreed: a 45% material share, base month 2026-08 and a 5% deadband. The agreement includes our binding annual requirement of 23,700 kg under these terms.

We understand your position on sharing further calculation details and will not pursue that request. Please send the contract confirmation reflecting the agreed price, payment basis, volume commitment and index mechanism, together with the fixed DAP delivery terms and lead time of 14 days.

Thank you for the constructive discussion and for accommodating the longer-term arrangement.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
out.rationale: Accept the supplier's standing offer rather than submit a lower price than the previous proposal. The supplier has confirmed the preferred payment terms and retained the agreed index mechanism and volume commitment.

out.subject: Supply agreement – fixed-price package
out.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for incorporating the verified processing-price evidence and approving payment at 90 days net with the 36-month volume commitment. That resolves the payment question. I also understand your position on sharing further calculation details; we need not reopen that discussion.

For your committee's review, I would like to offer a different balance between the starting price and alloy exposure: €5.52 per kg for 36 months, with payment at 90 days net and no index clause. Under this term sheet, our annual quantity of 23,700 kg remains binding. The higher starting price would therefore be paired with a fixed price throughout the agreement rather than subsequent alloy adjustments.

Please consider this package alongside the purchase-order history below, which documents the existing business behind our longer commitment. Can your pricing committee approve the fixed-price arrangement on this basis?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing
